title: Pension schemes newsletter 187 — November 2026
text:
Pension schemes newsletter 187 has articles on: 

 • using deconsolidated references for relief at source claims and adjustments 

 • relief at source residency status reports 

 • defined benefit pension scheme surplus payments to members 

 • the closure of the pension schemes online service 

 • qualifying recognised overseas pension schemes transfer data 

 • helping us design digitisation of relief at source
